name: Lazarus

fees.note: The fee is taken per miner from that miner's window share, by the path the work arrived on. Switching paths keeps the accepted work. 12.5% of stratum work's value is credited to DATUM miners on every block, pro rata by DATUM work, and paid with their next output.

shares_note: Accepted stays with your address whether you mine on the public stratum or through your own DATUM gateway. Window % is what the next block pays, not today's hashrate.
payout: A found block pays the TIDES window in its coinbase (0% fee through your own DATUM gateway, 25% on the public stratum; 12.5 points of the stratum fee is credited to DATUM miners): 8 network-blocks of accepted work, currently 100% full. Hashrate is not your cut — a new rig starts near 0% and ramps as its work enters and older work ages out.
